title: Online Matching with Stochastic Rewards: Provable Better Bound via Adversarial Reinforcement Learning

layout.note: Two mirrored dashed rounded regions side by side, each titled by a rotated bold label on its outer edge and holding the same agent-environment loop (the right copy flipped vertically). Two thick curved arcs, one over the top and one under the bottom, connect the regions and close a cycle between them.

lesson: Show an adversarial or co-trained pair by drawing the same RL loop twice (the second flipped) inside dashed regions with rotated titles, then close the cycle with two thick outer arcs named by what each agent hands to the other.
